sources.games: 1067 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 49.7%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py lich.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 31 (abilities named in fight and skills), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

rules.name: Glimmer Cape
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Glimmer Cape: after a 0.5 s delay, invisibility, 20% movement speed and a barrier absorbing up to 375 magic damage on you or an ally for 5 s, +20 magic resistance passive, 15 s cooldown. High-rank games against 3+ magic damage heroes: 72% of 81 games (55% otherwise), won 47% with it against 44% without. In his build (59% of the won games, ~19 min), so this is buying it earlier.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} puts a 375 magic damage barrier on you or an ally for 5 s
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} дає вам або союзнику магічний бар'єр на 375 шкоди на 5 с

rules.name: Ghost Scepter
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Ghost Scepter: Ghost Form for 4 s, immune to physical damage, unable to attack, 30% more magic damage taken, 22 s cooldown. High-rank games against 2+ physical carries: 30% of 37 games (16% otherwise), won 64% with it against 35% without (11 games with it).

reason.en: {enemy} and another physical carry are in their team: {item} makes you immune to physical damage for 4 s, though you cannot attack
reason.uk: {enemy} та ще один фізичний керрі в їхній команді: {item} робить вас невразливим до фізичної шкоди на 4 с, але атакувати в цей час не можна

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute (parts, consumables and Tranquil Boots dropped): glimmer_cape 59% (19), aghanims_shard 66% (23), blink 57% (26), force_staff 27% (26), ultimate_scepter 26% (37). STRATZ pos5 (10450 games): Glimmer Cape 19 min, Blink Dagger 20 min (91%), Aghanim's Scepter 33 min; it puts Blink before the Shard. Ordered by the STRATZ high-rank pos5 minute where STRATZ lists the item (10450 games), else the league minute (the player review of 2026-11-07: the STRATZ order where the two disagree).
